The Tent That Glows at Midnight

At FLWRPWR, we believe great flower begins with care, from the people who grow it to the way it is cultivated. We source from local, ethical growers who share our commitment to quality and thoughtful cultivation. Our premium smalls are grown with love, without harmful chemicals, and selected for their aroma, flavor, and character.

By day, the booth is all sunshine: sunflowers, daisies, and a table full of flower. By Halloween night, the same tent turns into the most haunted garden in town. The string lights die without warning. The pumpkins grin. The ghosts, sources confirm, are here for you.

Step inside below. Our walkable night tent is open in this very paper — wander the grass, browse the table, and round up the runaway jack-o'-lanterns before the lights go out.

Health, Wellness and Community

Tonight's attraction · Do not enter alone

After Dark at the FLWRPWR Tent

First-person horror inside the booth at night: branded canopy, dying string lights, flower buckets, the wholesale board, and the arched mirror sign — buried in fog, dead trees, and gravestones. Eight jack-o'-lanterns are hidden around the yard, and the things drifting between the lights are not friendly anymore. They hunt. They lunge. They scream. Round up all 8 pumpkins before the 90-second candle burns down — every pumpkin you take makes them faster, closer, and louder.

🎃 Pumpkins 0 / 8 🕯️ Time 1:30 ✨ Score 0 The tent awaits…
Click the tent to grab the mouse · Drag to look around · Esc releases
IT FOUND YOU

The tent is open. If you dare. 🌙

⚠ SCARE WARNING: This game contains sudden jumpscares, screaming faces lunging at the screen, flashing and blackout lights, loud stingers, and screen shake. Not for the faint of heart. Controls: Click the tent view to lock the mouse and look around (drag to look if your browser refuses the lock), WASD or arrows to walk, Esc to release the mouse. Walk into a pumpkin to collect it. Do not let them touch you.
